actionCompilation.source: immediate operations on public-visible variables plus immediate declared dependency link
actionCompilation.bundleRule: sum component public deltas in canonical action-id order
actionCompilation.recoveryKindRule: triage iff vital and ecology proxies improve; capacity_acquisition iff portability or recovery proxy improves; otherwise ordinary
actionCompilation.capacityGainRule: max(0, portability proxy delta, recovery proxy delta)
actionCompilation.restorationRule: no action is labeled restoration because Virelia supplies no receipt-backed institutional restoration semantics
actionCompilation.constitutionalTagsRule: no I13 tag inferred from physical labels without a population-level rights observable

profiles.purpose: matched enriched interface with non-compensating positive and negative public-proxy effects
profiles.expectedBoundary: method-added ontology disclosed equally to every contender

profiles.purpose: sensitivity test favorable to actionability by suppressing all compiled harms
profiles.expectedBoundary: deliberately optimistic evaluator variation, not a neutral world claim

reversalConditions: Withdraw any CCT performance attribution if results change across P1 and P2 without an explained mechanism.
Withdraw neutrality language because every executable profile adds ontology absent from the original Virelia view.
Treat a CCT refusal as a control failure at its observed tick; do not fabricate post-refusal material outcomes.
Do not infer rights or power validity from trust, harbor, seismic, material, disease or groundwater proxies.
statusBoundary: Written projection candidate. Proxy mappings and disclosed action semantics are evaluator model rules, not Virelia properties or validated constitutional constructs.
